protocol.threshold: frozen empirical order statistic from later clean validation; test is not used for threshold/model selection

policies.rolling_all_past: uses prior unlabeled test scores; causal but assumes prior scores are suitable calibration data
policies.rolling_non_alerts: updates only with prior non-alert scores; causal but non-alert does not imply clean

rolling_thresholds.injected_recall: counterfactual current-window injection scored against thresholds derived from the corresponding unmodified observed stream
rolling_thresholds.limitations: exploratory; the rolling stream is unadjudicated, windows overlap, and no calibration guarantee is claimed

protocol.defect_protocol: price-space corruption followed by causal recomputation of raw and standardized returns
limitations: test windows overlap by 75%; windows are not independent replicates
synthetic defect labels; no real incident prevalence or PPV
ROC AUC is descriptive on synthetic defects and overlapping windows; it is not a calibrated operating-point comparison
FPR is reported as observed and may differ from the nominal calibration target
the CNN marginal value is explored by XGB with versus without the CNN score on the same return feature bank; no winner is asserted from recall alone
